full.description: This image is a gross pathology photograph showing a bisected kidney specimen. The section reveals prominent pale yellow, necrotic areas and sloughing tissue within the renal papillae and medullary regions. These characteristic findings of tissue necrosis in the renal pyramids are most consistent with renal papillary necrosis.

blind.description: This is a gross specimen image of the urinary system showing both native end-stage kidneys and a renal allograft. The kidneys exhibit advanced structural damage characteristic of end-stage renal disease. The overall appearance is consistent with a patient who has undergone kidney transplantation alongside the removal or retention of diseased native kidneys.

random.description: This image shows a gross pathology specimen of a bisected kidney. The renal parenchyma exhibits pale, yellowish wedges of necrosis extending from the cortex towards the medulla, indicative of infarction. The findings are characteristic of renal infarction, likely caused by atherosclerotic emboli obstructing the renal arterial supply. The surrounding kidney tissue appears congested and hyperemic.
